question: What are two functions of the LAN Blade in the VSP Midrange family? (Choose two.) A. It provides the LAN connection to the file module. B. It provides the maintenance port connecting to the MPC. C. It provides the iSCSI connection to the servers. D. It provides the management port connecting to the customer LAN.

A customer wants to upgrade a VSP G700 to 512 GB RAM capacity. What is the valid CFM configuration? A. two BM35 per controller B. two BM45 per controller C. one BM45 per controller D. two BM35 per system
How many batteries does a VSP E1090 have per controller (CTL)? A. 1 B. 2 C. 3 D. 4

A customer has a VSP G370 with the encryption license key installed. They now want to have all the DP-Volumes of a certain pool located on encrypted RAID Groups. What are two requirements? (Choose two.) A. The controller board must support encryption. B. The RAID level of RAID Groups in the pool must be RAID 6. C. At least 20 GB of Shared Memory must be installed. D. The RAID Groups in the pool must be formatted with encryption enabled.
Which three RAID configurations are supported by VSP Midrange systems? (Choose three.) A. 2D + 2D B. 4D + 1P C. 7D + 1P D. 8D + 1P E. 10D + 2P

A customer wants to upgrade their VSP E790 with a SAS Expansion feature. What are three requirements? (Choose three.) A. Two additional Disk Boards (DKBs) have to be installed. B. Slots B of both controllers must be available for DKB installation. C. The SAS Expansion license has to be installed. D. In Shared Memory, the Extension1 has to be enabled. E. Drive Boxes (DBs) with SAS interface have to be added.
What are two valid back-end SAS cable connections on a VSP midrange system? (Choose two.) A. from DKA to DKB B. from ENC to ENC C. from DKB to ENC D. from DKA to SSW
Which two VSP systems support attached Drive Box Flash (DBF)? (Choose two.) A. VSP E590 B. VSP F370 C. VSP F700 D. VSP G900

A drive in a 3D + 1P RAID group fails in a VSP G700 and there is no spare drive available. Which two actions are automatically performed by the system? (Choose two.) A. An alert is generated. B. Dynamic Sparing is started. C. The Correction Copy process starts. D. The RAID group is placed in Correction Access.
Which manual should be used when performing maintenance actions on VSP midrange storage systems? A. Administrator Guide B. Product Documentation Library C. Maintenance Manual D. Service Guide

What are two consequences when a “New Installation” procedure is performed on a VSP Midrange system? (Choose two.) A. The SVP drive is formatted. B. The MPC software is updated. C. All the data on RAID groups is lost. D. The license keys are deleted.
Which program is used to perform the “New Installation” procedure on a VSP midrange system? A. MPC B. Webconsole C. GUM D. BECK
Which two tools are available to configure NTP server settings on a VSP E590 system? (Choose two.) A. Storage Navigator B. Maintenance Utility C. Initial Setup Wizard D. HSA Embedded

You are installing a new VSP G700 and are using the Initial Setup Wizard (ISW) for the network configuration. Which set of IP addresses is configured with the ISW? A. IP addresses of maintenance ports B. IP addresses of management ports C. IP addresses of all the ports D. IP addresses of all the ports and of the SVP

You are installing a VSP F370 and you need to connect your laptop to one of the controllers. What are the two default IP addresses of the maintenance ports of CTL1 and CTL2? (Choose two.) A. 10.0.0.17 B. 10.0.0.16 C. 192.168.0.17 D. 192.168.0.16
Which tool do you use to install license keys on a VSP G370 system? A. HSA Embedded B. MPC Software C. Storage Navigator D. Maintenance Utility

Which program is used to perform the “New Installation” procedure on a VSP F700 system? A. raidcom CLI B. Hitachi Ops Center Administrator C. SVP Web console D. MPC connected to the maintenance LAN port

You need to replace a broken disk drive on a VSP G700. What are two prerequisites? (Choose two.) A. You must use the Replace button in the Maintenance Utility before removing the drive. B. You must wear a wrist strap for ESD protection. C. The red LED on the drive must be lit. D. The Drive Box where the drive is located must be powered down.

You need to replace a broken fan in a VSP E1090. What is the correct procedure? A. Use the MPC for blocking the fan, then replace it. B. Use the Maintenance Utility for stopping the fan, then replace it. C. Remove the broken fan, then replace it. D. Use Storage Navigator for blocking the fan, then replace it.

You need to replace a failing power supply (PS) in a VSP E590. What is the correct procedure? A. Check if the status of the PS is blocked, and if yes, then replace it directly. B. Use the Maintenance Utility for blocking the PS, then replace it. C. Use the Maintenance Utility for blocking the controller, then replace the PS. D. Use the MPC for blocking the PS, then replace it.

The SVP of a VSP G900 system failed and you have been asked to replace it. Which two items must be available to perform the replacement? (Choose two.) A. the iso file with the correct version of Hitachi Ops Center B. the iso file with the correct version of the Windows operating system C. the microcode iso file with the correct software versions D. the Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent iso file

Which tool monitors a VSP E590 system and reports System Information Messages (SIMs)? A. Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent B. Hitachi Remote Ops SVP Agent C. Hitachi Ops Center Protector D. Storage Navigator

Which two statements are correct when adding cache to a VSP E590? (Choose two.) A. Cache modules must be installed in CMG1. B. Cache Modules must be installed on the CM board. C. CMG0 and CMG1 must have the same DIMM type. D. This is not supported online.

A customer wants to change a production RAID Group from RAID 5 (7D+1P) to RAID 6 (6D + 2P) on a VSP G700 during normal operations. They have just unmapped the LUNs from the channel ports. What needs to be performed next? A. The RAID level must be changed in Storage Navigator. B. The RAID level must be changed in the SVP Maintenance window. C. The RAID 5 Group must be put into DRU mode in Storage Navigator. D. The RAID Group must be deleted.
Which tool can be used to change System Option Modes (SOMs)? A. Hitachi Ops Center B. Webconsole C. HSAe D. MPC software

You have to perform a firmware update containing new code for DKCMain, CHBs and drives on a VSP G900. What are two requirements? (Choose two.) A. The CHBs must be updated first. B. The Microprocessor utilization should be below 50%. C. The Cache Write Pending rate should be below 30%. D. There should be no sparing processes running in the background.
You need to upgrade the firmware on a VSP G700. Which file must you select to perform the upgrade using the Maintenance Utility? A. All Firmware.mda B. HA-MPC-xx.iso C. HA-SVP-xx.iso D. setup.exe
Which tool is used for the remote monitoring of a VSP N800 system? A. Hitachi Remote Ops SVP Agent B. Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent C. MPC Software D. Hitachi Performance Monitor

Which two actions can be performed with Hitachi Ops Center Administrator? (Choose two.) A. Perform Self-Service Maintenance. B. Manage virtual storage machines. C. Manage multiple VSP Midrange storage systems. D. Configure the Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent.
What is the maximum size of a basic volume carved out from an internal parity group on a VSP E590 system? A. 1 TB B. 2.99 TB C. 65 TB D. 128 TB
What is the recommended RAID level when creating a Hitachi Dynamic Provisioning (HDP) pool? A. RAID 1 B. RAID 1+0 C. RAID 5 D. RAID 6

Your customer wants to connect multiple servers to a new port on a VSP G700. The correct topology has already been set for the port. What should you do next? A. Enable Port Security. B. Enable Host Group security. C. Create a Host Group. D. Scan for all WWNs.

Which two specifications may differ between models within the VSP Midrange family? (Choose two.) A. number of controllers B. number of CPUs and cores per controller C. number of drives supported D. number of power supplies

A customer wants to upgrade a VSP E1090 to 1TB RAM capacity. What is the valid Cache Flash Memory (CFM) configuration? A. one BM70 per controller B. two BM65 per controller C. two BM65 per system D. two BM70 per controller
Which three VSP Midrange storage arrays support hardware compression? (Choose three.) A. VSP E990 B. VSP E1090 C. VSP One B24 D. VSP One B26 E. VSP One B28
How many Disk Boards (DKBs) are included in a VSP E1090 system with at least one Drive Box (DB) attached? A. 1 B. 2 C. 4 D. 8

A drive in a VSP One B24 system is configured in a Dynamic Drive Protection (DDP) group. If this drive gets blocked as a result of a failure which process automatically starts to keep the DDP redundant? A. Correction Copy with spare drive B. Correction Copy with spare areas on drives C. Dynamic Sparing with spare areas on drives D. Dynamic Sparing with spare drive

You have to perform a "New Installation" of a VSP E790 system. What are three requirements for your maintenance laptop? (Choose three.) A. You must have a 32GB USB memory stick available B. Internet Information Service (IIS) must be configured C. The MPC software must be installed D. Firewall rules must be enabled E. An antivirus software must be installed

A VSP Е1090 customer wants to add another rack with Drive Boxes, however the new rack cannot be installed side-by-side with the controller rack. You plan to order SAS optical cables to connect the two racks together. Which three cables lengths are available (in meters)? (Choose three.) A. 5m B. 10m C. 30m D. 50m E. 100m

You are installing a VSP G350 system at a customer site. Which tool allows you to apply the license keys? A. Storage Navigator B. SVP Web Console C. Maintenance Utility D. HCS License Key Management System

From which two locations can the Maintenance Utility be invoked on a VSP One B26? (Choose two.) A. VSP One Block Administrator B. Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent C. SVP Web Console D. MPC connected to the Maintenance LAN port on the array

You need to replace a parts in a VSP E590. What are two ways for you to invoke the Maintenance Utility? (Choose two.) A. using the MPC connected to the Maintenance LAN port on the array B. using the BECK tool C. using the VSP One Block Administrator D. using HSAE

You need to replace a broken fan in the Backup Module with Fan BKMF21 on a VSP E1090. What is the correct procedure? A. Use the MPC to remove the power from the backup module, and when the fan has stopped replace it. B. Go directly to the system and replace the faulty fan. C. Use the Maintenance Utility for stopping the fan, then replace it. D. Use Storage Navigator to put the Backup Module into replacement mode, then replace the fan.

The SVP of a VSP G350 system failed and you have been asked to replace it. To perform the replacement which item do you need? A. a USB stick with the configuration backup B. the iso file with the correct version of the SVP Windows operating system C. the microcode iso file with the correct software versions D. the Hitachi Remote Ops Monitor Agent iso file

What are two ways to obtain information details on failed parts in a VSP Midrange system? (Choose two.) A. from the Maintenance Utility Interface B. from the Notification History window in VSP One Block Administrator C. from the audit log in HSAE D. from the MPC message logs in the Information menu
